title: Bind fixed realtime phases and telemetry to native adapters
requires: Native adapter build toolchains and the completed production shared-spatial integration
scope: Make realtime_schedule.hpp the production ordering authority for realtime-single-step-v1 on native adapters. Bind each phase to emitted kernels and F8-21 measurement without changing the legacy-default schedule or advertising the public profile.
acceptance: SimulationRuntime routes realtime-single-step-v1 through assemble_realtime_tick and binds boundary, predict, shared-index update/publication, exact domain iterations, batched coupling sweeps and atomic commit/abort to production work for every compiled native adapter.

The runtime executes exactly one 1/60 advance with no hidden substeps, catch-up, adaptive work, second spatial update or intra-tick host wait/readback; every failure preserves clock, state and pending inputs.

Measured execution reports actual per-phase dispatches, workgroups, barriers, submissions, bytes, iterations and spatial counters; GPU timing stays explicitly unsupported where unavailable and CPU time is never relabeled.

Negative injection exceeds each fixed work/synchronization limit and fails before commit; native CPU runtime tests and all available adapter compile/regression gates pass with legacy behavior unchanged.
